import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;
    static final long INF = 1000000000;
    
    static long N, K;
    
    static class Matrix {
        long[][] A;
        
        Matrix() {}
        
        Matrix(int n, int m) {
            A = new long[n][m];
        }
        
        Matrix(int n) {
            A = new long[n][n];
        }
        
        int n_rows() { return A.length; }
        int n_cols() { return A.length == 0 ? 0 : A[0].length; }
        
        long[] getRow(int idx) { return A[idx]; }
        
        static Matrix identity(int n) {
            Matrix mat = new Matrix(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) mat.A[i][i] = 1;
            return mat;
        }
        
        Matrix add(Matrix other) {
            Matrix tmp = new Matrix(this.n_rows(), this.n_cols());
            for (int i = 0; i < this.n_rows(); ++i)
                for (int j = 0; j < this.n_cols(); ++j)
                    tmp.A[i][j] = (this.A[i][j] + other.A[i][j]) % MOD;
            return tmp;
        }
        
        Matrix subtract(Matrix other) {
            Matrix tmp = new Matrix(this.n_rows(), this.n_cols());
            for (int i = 0; i < this.n_rows(); ++i)
                for (int j = 0; j < this.n_cols(); ++j)
                    tmp.A[i][j] = (this.A[i][j] - other.A[i][j] + MOD) % MOD;
            return tmp;
        }
        
        Matrix multiply(Matrix other) {
            int r1 = this.n_rows(), c1 = this.n_cols(), c2 = other.n_cols();
            Matrix res = new Matrix(r1, c2);
            for (int i = 0; i < r1; ++i)
                for (int k = 0; k < c1; ++k)
                    for (int j = 0; j < c2; ++j)
                        res.A[i][j] = (res.A[i][j] + this.A[i][k] * other.A[k][j]) % MOD;
            return res;
        }
        
        Matrix power(long exp) {
            Matrix res = Matrix.identity(this.n_rows());
            Matrix base = new Matrix(this.n_rows(), this.n_cols());
            for (int i = 0; i < this.n_rows(); ++i)
                for (int j = 0; j < this.n_cols(); ++j)
                    base.A[i][j] = this.A[i][j];
            
            while (exp > 0) {
                if ((exp & 1) == 1) res = res.multiply(base);
                base = base.multiply(base);
                exp >>= 1;
            }
            return res;
        }
        
        void rotate() {
            Matrix temp = new Matrix(this.n_rows());
            for (int i = 0; i < K; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j < K; ++j) {
                    temp.A[i][j] = this.A[(i + (int)K - 1) % (int)K][(j + (int)K - 1) % (int)K];
                }
                temp.A[i][(int)K] = this.A[(i + (int)K - 1) % (int)K][(int)K];
                temp.A[(int)K][i] = this.A[(int)K][(i + (int)K - 1) % (int)K];
            }
            temp.A[(int)K][(int)K] = this.A[(int)K][(int)K];
            this.A = temp.A;
        }
    }
    
    static Matrix[][] mat = new Matrix[70][35];
    
    static long ipow(long base, long exp) {
        if (exp == 0) return 1;
        long res = ipow(base, exp / 2);
        res = (res * res) % MOD;
        if ((exp & 1) == 1) res = (res * base) % MOD;
        return res;
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        N = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        K = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        
        long depth = 0;
        long tmp = N;
        while (tmp >= K) {
            depth++;
            tmp /= K;
        }
        
        mat[0][0] = Matrix.identity((int)K + 1);
        for (int i = 1; i < K + 1; ++i) mat[0][0].A[0][i] = 1;
        
        for (int i = 1; i < K; ++i) {
            mat[0][i] = new Matrix(mat[0][i-1].n_rows(), mat[0][i-1].n_cols());
            for (int x = 0; x < mat[0][i-1].n_rows(); ++x)
                for (int y = 0; y < mat[0][i-1].n_cols(); ++y)
                    mat[0][i].A[x][y] = mat[0][i-1].A[x][y];
            mat[0][i].rotate();
        }
        
        for (long idx = 1; idx <= depth; ++idx) {
            mat[idx][0] = new Matrix(mat[idx-1][0].n_rows(), mat[idx-1][0].n_cols());
            for (int x = 0; x < mat[idx-1][0].n_rows(); ++x)
                for (int y = 0; y < mat[idx-1][0].n_cols(); ++y)
                    mat[idx][0].A[x][y] = mat[idx-1][0].A[x][y];
            
            for (int i = 1; i < K; ++i) {
                mat[idx][0] = mat[idx-1][i].multiply(mat[idx][0]);
            }
            
            for (int i = 1; i < K; ++i) {
                mat[idx][i] = new Matrix(mat[idx][i-1].n_rows(), mat[idx][i-1].n_cols());
                for (int x = 0; x < mat[idx][i-1].n_rows(); ++x)
                    for (int y = 0; y < mat[idx][i-1].n_cols(); ++y)
                        mat[idx][i].A[x][y] = mat[idx][i-1].A[x][y];
                mat[idx][i].rotate();
            }
        }
        
        Matrix ans = new Matrix((int)K + 1, 1);
        ans.A[(int)K][0] = 1;
        int offset = 0;
        
        while (depth >= 0) {
            for (int i = 0; ; ++i) {
                if (ipow(K, depth) <= N) {
                    N -= ipow(K, depth);
                    ans = mat[(int)depth][offset].multiply(ans);
                    offset = (offset + 1) % (int)K;
                } else {
                    break;
                }
            }
            depth--;
        }
        
        long total = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < K + 1; ++i) {
            total = (total + ans.A[i][0]) % MOD;
        }
        System.out.println(total);
    }
}
